mission: The valley opens below. Three-way geometry: Veraine's ritual distortion at the Scar's base, Torin descending the far ridgeline, the resonance group at mid-valley. Desh split off toward the first amplification node. Ben calls across the distance to Torin. Torin pauses and responds — genuine affection, the use of 'Ben' instead of a title. He begins the technique.
why_now: All three operations have to be visible simultaneously for the climax geometry to land. Ben's last appeal to Torin has to happen before the technique activates; Torin's response has to close the relationship with warmth rather than anger.
conflict: Ben is running out of sentences. He tries to reach Torin through the Force, through words, through shared history. Torin hears him, answers honestly, and keeps walking. The refusal is delivered with love, which is the worst version of it.
turning_point: Torin across the valley: 'I understand what you're trying to do, Ben. It's the right impulse. But some problems only have one solution.' The use of 'Ben' is the weight of the line. He begins the technique.
opening_hook: The valley opens below them. Three-way geometry: Veraine at the Scar, Torin descending the ridgeline, the resonance group at mid-valley. Desh already gone — heading to the first amplification node.
closing_hook: Torin begins the technique. Ben feels it — the lattice near Torin leaning toward him and dissolving. A pulling, a suction. Like standing next to a drain.
emotional_trajectory: Desperate hope for Torin -> the failed appeal's grief -> the technique activating

stakes.personal: Ben's last attempt to save Torin — and the acceptance that he cannot force it
stakes.interpersonal: The Ben/Torin relationship's final exchange — genuine love across irreconcilable choices
stakes.external: The three-way convergence at the Scar is about to collide

setting: Veranthos — valley approach, ridgeline visible, the Scar at the valley floor
sensory_details: The valley's geometry — ridgelines, slopes, the Scar at the lowest point; Torin's descending figure, unhurried; the technique activating as the lattice near him leans inward and dissolves, a visible suction drawing on the Force around him; Veraine's ritual distortion visible at the Scar as a heat-shimmer of motion
action_beats: The group descends into the valley in formation while Desh splits off toward the first amplification node
Ben calls across the valley to Torin and Torin pauses on the ridgeline, turning to listen
Torin begins the technique and the lattice near him leans inward and dissolves — a pulling, a suction
notes: Torin's use of 'Ben' instead of a title carries the scene's weight — the rejection is affectionate, not cold. Anti-pattern: Torin does not give a speech; the line travels across distance as a single short exchange. The technique's activation uses the force_mechanics vocabulary of active structural violence (a pulling, a suction, a drain) — one consistent image, do not stack metaphors. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, narrate his final acceptance that he cannot force Torin. The action is: he calls, Torin answers, the technique activates, the group keeps moving.
